title: Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning at Small Scale

paragraphs.text: We fine-tune a vision transformer on a small image benchmark and compare it with a convolutional baseline. The study is deliberately narrow.
We fine-tune ViT-B/16 on CIFAR-100 for 30 epochs with a batch size of 64. Only the classification head and the last block are updated.
All experiments use CIFAR-100; we report top-1 accuracy on the test split.
ViT-B/16 fine-tuning reaches 91.2% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-100, 1.5 points above the CNN baseline.
The comparison uses different image resolutions from the original ViT paper, so absolute numbers are not comparable across studies.
Fine-tuning a small ViT is competitive on CIFAR-100, but the result does not transfer to ImageNet-scale claims.
